data.completion_memo: Implemented evidence paging/filtering and exact JSON inspection. Provenance, usage, routing, approvals, artifacts, retries, and debug records retain explicit available/redacted/expired/unsupported/opaque state; unavailable facts never receive inferred values. The Chat screen has stable evidence selection and displays redacted JSON safely.
data.description: Implement stable evidence selection, summary/detail queries, pagination, filters, redacted JSON inspection, provenance, usage/cost, routing, approvals, artifacts, retries, opacity, retention, and debug-capture availability. Missing, expired, unsupported, redacted, or source-opaque evidence must remain explicit and never be inferred.
